components.name: Decision Panel
components.description: Warm working surface with organic corners.
components.css: .ds-panel{padding:24px;border:1px solid #d7cfc4;border-radius:24px 44px 28px 38px;background:#fffefa;color:#2c2c24;box-shadow:0 18px 48px -28px rgba(93,112,82,.48);font:500 15px/1.6 Nunito,sans-serif}.ds-panel strong{font:700 28px Fraunces,serif}.ds-panel p{color:#68685e}

narrative.overview: A calm working session around a well-used planning table: tactile, grounded, and human without compromising operational clarity.

rules.name: The Earthbound Signal Rule
rules.body: Saturated color is reserved for actions, weights, and decision signals.

dos: Do preserve a calm, tactile hierarchy around a dense decision task.
donts: Don't introduce violet, neon accents, or hard offset shadows.
